title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘~Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier
focus: 潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束~Coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads
summary: 本課以荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘為入口，深入潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
history: 東斯海爾德防潮閘位於荷蘭澤蘭，以平常保持開口、風暴時形成屏障的方式，兼顧潮汐環境與防洪需求。北海大洪水促成荷蘭強化防洪的三角洲工程計畫。 東斯海爾德防潮閘工程開始建設，後續保留開放潮汐設計。 東斯海爾德防潮閘完成，形成長期海口防護設施。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~The Eastern Scheldt Barrier in Zeeland combines normally open tidal exchange with storm protection, making ecological exchange and structural loading inseparable engineering questions. The North Sea flood prompts the Netherlands to strengthen protection through the Delta Works. Construction begins on the Eastern Scheldt Barrier with an open tidal configuration. The Eastern Scheldt Barrier is completed as a long-term estuary protection structure. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 開口流速與收縮~Opening velocity and contraction
units.title: 開口流速與收縮~Opening velocity and contraction
units.mechanism: 保留潮汐交換需要流通面積，但墩柱壓縮通道使局部速度上升。斷面平均速度不是閘緣噴流速度，動壓與紊流剪應力又隨速度平方變化。比較同一流量的不同開口，才能看見縮窄後的海床代價。 假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。 局部高速帶若穿過未保護接縫，平均流速正常仍可能淘空床層。潮向翻轉會把危險區換邊，因此只有單向測線無法確認完整保護範圍。~Preserving tidal exchange requires flow area, while piers contract the channels and accelerate local currents. Section-mean velocity differs from the gate-edge jet. Dynamic pressure and turbulent stresses depend on velocity squared, so comparing openings at fixed discharge reveals the seabed consequences of contraction. Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. A narrow fast jet crossing an unprotected joint may erode the bed despite an acceptable average velocity. Tidal reversal moves the vulnerable side, so one-direction transects cannot establish the full protection footprint.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation.
units.verify: 把聲學流速剖面按同一潮相積分，核對斷面流量與上下游水位差；另取閘緣測線，避免以河道中央的單點值代表整個收縮流場。以收縮前後斷面重複量測檢查連續方程的閉合，量化遺漏側向流的大小。~Integrate acoustic velocity profiles at matched tidal phases and compare section discharge with the water-level difference. Add gate-edge transects instead of treating a central point as the entire contracted flow field. Repeat upstream and downstream transects to close continuity and quantify any omitted lateral flow contribution.
units.failure: 局部高速帶若穿過未保護接縫，平均流速正常仍可能淘空床層。潮向翻轉會把危險區換邊，因此只有單向測線無法確認完整保護範圍。~A narrow fast jet crossing an unprotected joint may erode the bed despite an acceptable average velocity. Tidal reversal moves the vulnerable side, so one-direction transects cannot establish the full protection footprint.
units.misconception: 開口平均流速相同就能保證閘緣沖刷完全相同。~Equal opening-average velocity guarantees identical gate-edge scour.
units.practice: 以開口流速與收縮編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把聲學流速剖面按同一潮相積分，核對斷面流量與上下游水位差；另取閘緣測線，避免以河道中央的單點值代表整個收縮流場。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for opening velocity and contraction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate acoustic velocity profiles at matched tidal phases and compare section discharge with the water-level difference. Add gate-edge transects instead of treating a central point as the entire contracted flow field.

units.anchor: 潮稜體與生態交換~Tidal prism and ecological exchange
units.title: 潮稜體與生態交換~Tidal prism and ecological exchange
units.mechanism: 潮稜體衡量一個漲潮期間進出的水量，不能直接當成全部水體換新。港灣分支與渦流會保留舊水，同時影響鹽度與棲地。把幾何儲水量和示蹤交換效率分開，可避免以流量總和誤判生態效果。 假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。 只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。~The tidal prism measures water exchanged during a flood tide, but does not mean every parcel is renewed. Branches and recirculation retain older water and influence salinity and habitats. Separating geometric storage from tracer exchange prevents cumulative flow from being mistaken for ecological renewal. Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers. A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. Counting recirculated seawater repeatedly as new inflow underestimates contaminant residence and can conceal localized oxygen depletion.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers.
units.verify: 對齊潮位基準、濕潤面積曲線與鹽度剖面；比較漲落潮的示蹤訊號是否返回，並以多個分支測站判斷完全混合假設在哪些區域失效。以退潮示蹤回返比例估算再循環，將實際更新率與純幾何潮稜體分開報告。~Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles. Compare tracer returns between flood and ebb, using stations in several branches to identify where the complete-mixing assumption fails. Estimate recirculation from returning ebb tracers and report actual renewal separately from the geometric tidal prism.
units.failure: 只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。~A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. Counting recirculated seawater repeatedly as new inflow underestimates contaminant residence and can conceal localized oxygen depletion.
units.misconception: 潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。~A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner.
units.practice: 以潮稜體與生態交換編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對齊潮位基準、濕潤面積曲線與鹽度剖面；比較漲落潮的示蹤訊號是否返回，並以多個分支測站判斷完全混合假設在哪些區域失效。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tidal prism and ecological exchange, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles. Compare tracer returns between flood and ebb, using stations in several branches to identify where the complete-mixing assumption fails.

units.anchor: 雙側水壓合力~Differential hydrostatic gate force
units.title: 雙側水壓合力~Differential hydrostatic gate force
units.mechanism: 閘門承受兩側壓力之差，兩邊都濕潤時不能只畫上游三角形。合力大小與作用點分別決定傳遞到支承的剪力及彎矩；潮位反轉時也必須檢查相反方向的接觸與止水。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設直立矩形板寬10 m，兩側水深6及4 m，同密度淡水且靜止；F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN，不含波浪或海水密度差。 測站基準差會造成虛假淨水頭，導致支承反力估計偏移。若忽略波浪瞬時吸力或門體變形，靜水合力相符仍不能證明焊縫與導輪安全。~A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet. Resultant magnitude and elevation determine support shear and moment. Reversing the tide also reverses contact and seal demands. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume a vertical rectangular plate ten metres wide, still fresh water depths 6 and 4 m: F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN, excluding waves and seawater density differences. A gauge datum mismatch creates false net head and shifts inferred reactions. Ignoring transient wave suction or gate deformation means agreement with hydrostatic force cannot demonstrate weld or guide-wheel adequacy.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設直立矩形板寬10 m，兩側水深6及4 m，同密度淡水且靜止；F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN，不含波浪或海水密度差。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume a vertical rectangular plate ten metres wide, still fresh water depths 6 and 4 m: F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN, excluding waves and seawater density differences.
units.verify: 分別繪出兩側壓力圖後相減，再對底部積分求彎矩；將水位計的共同基準與閘門幾何測量交叉核對，不能用壓差單值猜合力作用點。檢查壓力積分同時滿足合力及力矩平衡，並對水位基準偏差作敏感度分析。~Plot both pressure diagrams, subtract them and integrate moments about the base. Cross-check the gauges common datum against surveyed gate geometry rather than inferring the resultant elevation from one pressure difference. Check that pressure integration satisfies both force and moment balance and test sensitivity to gauge-datum offsets.
units.failure: 測站基準差會造成虛假淨水頭，導致支承反力估計偏移。若忽略波浪瞬時吸力或門體變形，靜水合力相符仍不能證明焊縫與導輪安全。~A gauge datum mismatch creates false net head and shifts inferred reactions. Ignoring transient wave suction or gate deformation means agreement with hydrostatic force cannot demonstrate weld or guide-wheel adequacy.
units.misconception: 兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。~Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet.
units.practice: 以雙側水壓合力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別繪出兩側壓力圖後相減，再對底部積分求彎矩；將水位計的共同基準與閘門幾何測量交叉核對，不能用壓差單值猜合力作用點。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for differential hydrostatic gate force, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot both pressure diagrams, subtract them and integrate moments about the base. Cross-check the gauges common datum against surveyed gate geometry rather than inferring the resultant elevation from one pressure difference.

units.anchor: 反濾層顆粒保持~Filter particle retention
units.title: 反濾層顆粒保持~Filter particle retention
units.mechanism: 護床石下方的細土不能被水流穿過大孔隙帶走，反濾層須同時保持基土並讓水排出。單一粒徑比例只是初步篩選；廣級配、分散性與流向反轉需要材料試驗，不能靠增厚大石代替細部相容。 假設基土d85=0.5 mm、反濾料D15=1.8 mm，保持比D15/d85=3.6；只作粒徑比較，不宣稱適用所有土類的驗收門檻。 粗料看似排水良好卻可能放走細土，過細反濾層則會堵塞並增加上浮水壓。若只檢查料場樣品，現場離析形成的薄弱帶可能完全漏判。~Fine foundation soil must not migrate through voids beneath armor. Filters must retain the base soil while allowing drainage. A grain-size ratio is only screening evidence; broad grading, dispersivity and flow reversal require material testing rather than simply placing thicker large rock. Assume base-soil d85=0.5 mm and filter D15=1.8 mm. Their retention ratio is 3.6, a grading comparison rather than an acceptance limit applicable to every soil. Coarse material may drain freely while losing soil; an overly fine filter can clog and raise uplift. Stockpile-only testing can entirely miss weak bands produced by segregation during placement.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.5 mm、反濾料D15=1.8 mm，保持比D15/d85=3.6；只作粒徑比較，不宣稱適用所有土類的驗收門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base-soil d85=0.5 mm and filter D15=1.8 mm. Their retention ratio is 3.6, a grading comparison rather than an acceptance limit applicable to every soil.
units.verify: 從鋪設後取樣重建粒徑曲線，檢查運輸離析與細料流失；用方向可反轉的滲流試驗比較出水濁度、沉降與水頭損失，保存原土分類。比較鋪設前後細料比例，記錄試驗出水是否夾帶基土而非只是反濾料表面粉塵。~Reconstruct grading from placed samples and check segregation and fines loss. Use reversible-flow seepage tests to compare effluent turbidity, settlement and head loss while retaining the base-soil classification. Compare fines before and after placement and identify whether effluent contains base soil rather than surface dust.
units.failure: 粗料看似排水良好卻可能放走細土，過細反濾層則會堵塞並增加上浮水壓。若只檢查料場樣品，現場離析形成的薄弱帶可能完全漏判。~Coarse material may drain freely while losing soil; an overly fine filter can clog and raise uplift. Stockpile-only testing can entirely miss weak bands produced by segregation during placement.
units.misconception: 反濾料越粗越厚就一定越能阻止基土流失。~Coarser and thicker filter material always prevents more base-soil loss.
units.practice: 以反濾層顆粒保持編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從鋪設後取樣重建粒徑曲線，檢查運輸離析與細料流失；用方向可反轉的滲流試驗比較出水濁度、沉降與水頭損失，保存原土分類。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for filter particle retention, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct grading from placed samples and check segregation and fines loss. Use reversible-flow seepage tests to compare effluent turbidity, settlement and head loss while retaining the base-soil classification.

units.anchor: 護床起動與尺度~Armor mobility and scale
units.title: 護床起動與尺度~Armor mobility and scale
units.mechanism: 床粒起動受流體剪應力與顆粒有效重量競爭控制。Shields參數把尺寸和密度納入同一比值，但局部亂流、坡度及石塊咬合會改變實際起動。它適合比較候選護床，不直接決定完整海床保護設計。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設床剪應力30 Pa、石密度2650、水密度1000 kg/m³、粒徑0.1 m；θ=30/((2650−1000)9.81×0.1)=0.01853，非通用臨界值。 邊緣保護長度不足會產生淘刷坑，再向墩底倒退侵蝕。即使石塊本身未被搬走，下面的反濾料被抽出仍可能使護床整片下沉。~Particle motion reflects competition between fluid shear and submerged particle weight. The Shields parameter includes size and density, but local turbulence, slope and interlocking alter actual initiation. It compares candidate protection materials without determining a complete seabed protection design. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume shear stress 30 Pa, rock and water densities 2650 and 1000 kg/m³, diameter 0.1 m: θ=30/((2650−1000)9.81×0.1)=0.01853. This is not a universal critical value. Insufficient edge protection creates a scour hole that can migrate back toward the pier. Even immobile armor can subside as a sheet when underlying filter material is removed through its voids.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設床剪應力30 Pa、石密度2650、水密度1000 kg/m³、粒徑0.1 m；θ=30/((2650−1000)9.81×0.1)=0.01853，非通用臨界值。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume shear stress 30 Pa, rock and water densities 2650 and 1000 kg/m³, diameter 0.1 m: θ=30/((2650−1000)9.81×0.1)=0.01853. This is not a universal critical value.
units.verify: 比較不同潮相的近床紊流與重複測深，將石粒移位標記到坡面、邊界和接縫；用試驗確認起動分散程度，而非只查一個平均粒徑。沿護床外緣建立固定測深斷面，辨認淘刷坑是否朝基礎方向持續後退侵蝕。~Compare near-bed turbulence and repeat bathymetry across tidal phases. Map displaced stones to slopes, edges and joints, and use tests to characterize variability in initiation rather than checking only mean diameter. Establish repeatable edge bathymetry sections and determine whether scour holes progressively retreat toward the foundation.
units.failure: 邊緣保護長度不足會產生淘刷坑，再向墩底倒退侵蝕。即使石塊本身未被搬走，下面的反濾料被抽出仍可能使護床整片下沉。~Insufficient edge protection creates a scour hole that can migrate back toward the pier. Even immobile armor can subside as a sheet when underlying filter material is removed through its voids.
units.misconception: 只要護床石塊沒有移動，下方基土就一定沒有流失。~Stationary armor guarantees that underlying soil has not been lost.
units.practice: 以護床起動與尺度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較不同潮相的近床紊流與重複測深，將石粒移位標記到坡面、邊界和接縫；用試驗確認起動分散程度，而非只查一個平均粒徑。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for armor mobility and scale, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare near-bed turbulence and repeat bathymetry across tidal phases. Map displaced stones to slopes, edges and joints, and use tests to characterize variability in initiation rather than checking only mean diameter.

units.anchor: 墩底接觸偏心~Eccentric pier bearing
units.title: 墩底接觸偏心~Eccentric pier bearing
units.mechanism: 巨型墩底將門體水平荷載轉成基礎壓力分布，偏心越大越可能出現局部脫離。線性接觸模型只有在全底面受壓時適用；海床不平、局部沖刷與土體壓縮會使剛體假設改變。 假設每延米底寬12 m、豎力2400 kN/m、偏心1 m，全壓線性模型q=V/B(1±6e/B)，得到300及100 kPa；未考慮上浮。 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。若線性式算出拉應力仍保留全接觸面積，後續承載力分析會系統性低估局部集中。~A large pier converts gate horizontal loading into foundation pressure. Increasing eccentricity can cause partial separation. Linear contact stress applies only with full compression; uneven seabed, local scour and compressible ground can invalidate the assumed rigid-base behavior. Assume base width 12 m, vertical force 2400 kN/m and eccentricity 1 m. Full-contact linear q=V/B(1±6e/B) gives 300 and 100 kPa, before uplift is considered. Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading. Keeping a full contact area after the linear solution predicts tension systematically understates local stress concentration.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每延米底寬12 m、豎力2400 kN/m、偏心1 m，全壓線性模型q=V/B(1±6e/B)，得到300及100 kPa；未考慮上浮。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base width 12 m, vertical force 2400 kN/m and eccentricity 1 m. Full-contact linear q=V/B(1±6e/B) gives 300 and 100 kPa, before uplift is considered.
units.verify: 把傾斜、沉降與底部孔壓的時間序列同步，先扣除潮汐彈性反應，再查反覆荷載後是否留下殘餘位移；重算淨豎力和接觸面積。分別計算扣除孔壓前後的合力位置，檢查最小接觸應力是否仍保持受壓。~Synchronize tilt, settlement and foundation pore-pressure histories. Separate reversible tidal response from residual displacement after loading, then recalculate net vertical force and actual contact area. Calculate resultant locations before and after uplift subtraction and confirm the minimum contact stress remains compressive.
units.failure: 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。若線性式算出拉應力仍保留全接觸面積，後續承載力分析會系統性低估局部集中。~Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading. Keeping a full contact area after the linear solution predicts tension systematically understates local stress concentration.
units.misconception: 基底算出拉力時仍可直接沿用全接觸線性壓力式。~Full-contact linear base-pressure equations remain valid after predicting tension.
units.practice: 以墩底接觸偏心編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把傾斜、沉降與底部孔壓的時間序列同步，先扣除潮汐彈性反應，再查反覆荷載後是否留下殘餘位移；重算淨豎力和接觸面積。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for eccentric pier bearing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Synchronize tilt, settlement and foundation pore-pressure histories. Separate reversible tidal response from residual displacement after loading, then recalculate net vertical force and actual contact area.

units.anchor: 潮位滯後與上浮~Tidal lag and uplift
units.title: 潮位滯後與上浮~Tidal lag and uplift
units.mechanism: 潮水變化傳入地基孔隙需要時間，因此外部低潮不保證墩底孔壓也低。排水路徑與滲透率決定壓力滯後，必須用同時刻的外水位與基底壓力計算有效重量。靜態最高水位包絡未必捕捉最差組合。 假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。 排水堵塞可能先表現為退潮後孔壓消散變慢，而不是最大讀數突然增高。只看每日峰值會錯過有效重量最低的短暫階段，掩蓋滑動敏感期。~Tidal changes take time to propagate through foundation pores, so low external water does not ensure low pressure beneath a pier. Drainage paths and permeability control lag. Effective weight requires simultaneous external and basal pressures, not unrelated maximum-level envelopes. Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Additional uplift U=ΔuA=5000 kN. Uniform pressure is assumed, excluding phase differences across the base. Drainage blockage may first appear as slower dissipation after ebb rather than a higher peak reading. Daily maxima alone miss brief minimum-effective-weight periods and conceal increased sliding sensitivity.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Additional uplift U=ΔuA=5000 kN. Uniform pressure is assumed, excluding phase differences across the base.
units.verify: 以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。計算外水位與孔壓的交叉相關延遲，確認滯後可在多個完整潮週期重現。~Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Compare integrated uplift with the timing of observed pier tilting. Calculate the cross-correlation lag between external level and pore pressure and confirm repeatability across complete tidal cycles.
units.failure: 排水堵塞可能先表現為退潮後孔壓消散變慢，而不是最大讀數突然增高。只看每日峰值會錯過有效重量最低的短暫階段，掩蓋滑動敏感期。~Drainage blockage may first appear as slower dissipation after ebb rather than a higher peak reading. Daily maxima alone miss brief minimum-effective-weight periods and conceal increased sliding sensitivity.
units.misconception: 外海達到低潮時，基底孔壓必定同時達到最低。~Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide.
units.practice: 以潮位滯後與上浮編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tidal lag and uplift, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Compare integrated uplift with the timing of observed pier tilting.

units.anchor: 弗勞德縮尺相似~Froude model similarity
units.title: 弗勞德縮尺相似~Froude model similarity
units.mechanism: 重力主導自由水面的試驗需保持弗勞德數，速度和時間按長度平方根縮放。黏性與表面張力通常不能同時滿足相似，所以模型中的薄水層與小顆粒運動可能失真，量測結果必須附尺度限制。 假設原型與模型長度比25:1，模型流速0.4 m/s；原型速度為0.4√25=2 m/s，模型60 s對應原型300 s；僅適用重力相似。 把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。即使水面曲線相似，沖刷深度仍可能受到顆粒尺度效應支配，不能只靠影片判斷。~Gravity-dominated free-surface tests preserve Froude number, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity and surface tension generally cannot also be matched, so thin flows and small particle motions may distort and require explicit scale qualifications. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio 25:1 and model velocity 0.4 m/s. Prototype velocity is 0.4√25=2 m/s; model 60 s represents 300 s, under gravity similarity only. Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism. Even similar water-surface curves may accompany scale-dependent scour depths, so visual similarity alone is not adequate validation.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原型與模型長度比25:1，模型流速0.4 m/s；原型速度為0.4√25=2 m/s，模型60 s對應原型300 s；僅適用重力相似。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume prototype-to-model length ratio 25:1 and model velocity 0.4 m/s. Prototype velocity is 0.4√25=2 m/s; model 60 s represents 300 s, under gravity similarity only.
units.verify: 先列出長度、時間、速度與流量各自縮尺，再用無因次水位和速度曲線比較多個模型尺寸；若曲線不能重合，查雷諾數與表面張力效應。分別列出雷諾數和韋伯數偏差，確認被解讀的現象確實由重力而非其他作用主導。~List separate length, time, velocity and discharge scales, then compare dimensionless level and velocity curves across model sizes. Failure to collapse the curves prompts checks of Reynolds-number and surface-tension effects. Report Reynolds and Weber mismatches separately and verify that gravity dominates the particular phenomenon being interpreted.
units.failure: 把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。即使水面曲線相似，沖刷深度仍可能受到顆粒尺度效應支配，不能只靠影片判斷。~Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism. Even similar water-surface curves may accompany scale-dependent scour depths, so visual similarity alone is not adequate validation.
units.misconception: 模型水面符合弗勞德相似，顆粒運動就必然正確縮尺。~Froude-similar water surfaces guarantee correctly scaled sediment movement.
units.practice: 以弗勞德縮尺相似編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先列出長度、時間、速度與流量各自縮尺，再用無因次水位和速度曲線比較多個模型尺寸；若曲線不能重合，查雷諾數與表面張力效應。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for froude model similarity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. List separate length, time, velocity and discharge scales, then compare dimensionless level and velocity curves across model sizes. Failure to collapse the curves prompts checks of Reynolds-number and surface-tension effects.

units.anchor: 預報偏差與時間裕度~Forecast bias and time margin
units.title: 預報偏差與時間裕度~Forecast bias and time margin
units.mechanism: 防潮決策必須在危險水位抵達前完成資訊、判斷與機械動作。預報水位誤差和到達時間誤差是不同量，海象快速惡化時不能互相替代。課堂只分析時間預算，不重建任何設施的實際關閘規則。 假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。 通訊中斷、供電擾動與人員確認可能同受一場風暴影響，直接相加獨立平均值會高估裕度。時間戳不一致也可能把資料延遲誤認為機械遲緩。~A protective decision must accommodate information, assessment and mechanical response before hazardous water arrives. Water-level error differs from arrival-time error and cannot substitute for it during rapid change. The classroom model examines a time budget without reproducing operational closure rules. Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min. Remaining margin is 40 min; all are assumed and exclude correlated delays and forecast uncertainty. Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min. Remaining margin is 40 min; all are assumed and exclude correlated delays and forecast uncertainty.
units.verify: 在歷次演練資料標註預報發行、接收、確認與完成時間，以同一時鐘計算分布；另列漏報與假警報，不能只報平均完成時間來評價決策品質。以最慢實測階段重建時間預算，檢查不確定度同時放大時是否仍有足夠裕度。~Timestamp forecast issue, receipt, confirmation and completion in exercise records using one clock. Evaluate missed events and false alarms separately instead of judging decisions solely by average completion time. Rebuild the budget using slow observed stages and assess remaining margin when several uncertainties increase together.
units.failure: 通訊中斷、供電擾動與人員確認可能同受一場風暴影響，直接相加獨立平均值會高估裕度。時間戳不一致也可能把資料延遲誤認為機械遲緩。~Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery.
units.misconception: 平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。~Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm.
units.practice: 以預報偏差與時間裕度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在歷次演練資料標註預報發行、接收、確認與完成時間，以同一時鐘計算分布；另列漏報與假警報，不能只報平均完成時間來評價決策品質。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for forecast bias and time margin, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Timestamp forecast issue, receipt, confirmation and completion in exercise records using one clock. Evaluate missed events and false alarms separately instead of judging decisions solely by average completion time.

units.anchor: 腐蝕餘厚與疲勞~Corrosion allowance and fatigue
units.title: 腐蝕餘厚與疲勞~Corrosion allowance and fatigue
units.mechanism: 鹽水環境的板件減薄降低截面能力，但焊趾疲勞又取決於局部應力範圍與循環數。均勻腐蝕速率只做餘厚預測，不能替代點蝕量測或裂紋檢查；維護判讀要把材料損失和疲勞機制分列。 假設初厚20 mm、均勻腐蝕0.08 mm/year、經過15 years，餘厚18.8 mm；若截面寬不變，面積損失6%，不據此推定疲勞壽命。 以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。~Saline exposure reduces plate section, while weld fatigue depends on local stress range and cycle count. Uniform corrosion rate predicts remaining thickness but cannot replace pitting surveys or crack inspection. Maintenance interpretation must separate material loss from cyclic damage. Assume initial thickness 20 mm and uniform corrosion 0.08 mm/year over 15 years. Remaining thickness is 18.8 mm and area loss is six percent at constant width; fatigue life is not inferred. Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設初厚20 mm、均勻腐蝕0.08 mm/year、經過15 years，餘厚18.8 mm；若截面寬不變，面積損失6%，不據此推定疲勞壽命。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume initial thickness 20 mm and uniform corrosion 0.08 mm/year over 15 years. Remaining thickness is 18.8 mm and area loss is six percent at constant width; fatigue life is not inferred.
units.verify: 固定網格重複超音波測厚，特別覆蓋水線、焊縫與積水角；以塗層狀況和裂紋檢測對照厚度趨勢，保留儀器校正及量測位置重現性。對最薄位置做獨立重測並檢查焊趾，將平均腐蝕率與局部極值分別存檔。~Repeat ultrasonic thickness measurements on a fixed grid covering waterlines, welds and trapped-water corners. Compare coating condition and crack inspection with thickness trends, preserving calibration and location repeatability. Independently repeat the thinnest readings and inspect weld toes, preserving mean corrosion rate separately from local extremes.
units.failure: 以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。~Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate.
units.misconception: 只要板件餘厚足夠，焊縫就不可能存在疲勞裂紋。~Adequate remaining plate thickness rules out fatigue cracks at welds.
units.practice: 以腐蝕餘厚與疲勞編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。固定網格重複超音波測厚，特別覆蓋水線、焊縫與積水角；以塗層狀況和裂紋檢測對照厚度趨勢，保留儀器校正及量測位置重現性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for corrosion allowance and fatigue, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Repeat ultrasonic thickness measurements on a fixed grid covering waterlines, welds and trapped-water corners. Compare coating condition and crack inspection with thickness trends, preserving calibration and location repeatability.

facts: 官方全長9 km，其中約3 km為可關閉段。~Official length is 9 km, with approximately 3 km closable.
官方構造包含65座墩與62座閘門。~The official configuration includes 65 piers and 62 gates.
教學6000 m³/s除3000 m²得到平均2 m/s。~Teaching discharge 6000 m³/s over 3000 m² gives mean velocity 2 m/s.
教學25 kPa作用200 m²產生5000 kN上浮。~Teaching pressure 25 kPa over 200 m² produces 5000 kN uplift.
教學縮尺25:1的弗勞德時間比為5:1。~A teaching Froude length ratio 25:1 gives time ratio 5:1.
教學20 mm板均勻腐蝕15年後為18.8 mm。~A teaching 20 mm plate after fifteen years of assumed uniform corrosion is 18.8 mm.
